lead: No registry spelling can make a `mixed` parameter refuse a qualifier, so a gap reading as a missing `CoreTy` is a missing call-site rule.
body: A `Qual` never refuses on its own — `expr::args` only *narrows* the compared type for a mark that admits one, so every refusal is `is_assignable`'s, and `crates/nvs-types/src/expr/assign.rs:70` accepts every qualified atom into `mixed`. Write it beside its siblings in `nvs_types::expr::quals`, over the written argument, and file its check under the crate that owns the diagnostic.
